# Introduction

## About me

Statistical programmer working in the pharma industry since 2015. Using SAS and SQL as primary tools for data processing and reporting. 

## Purpose of this webpage

- Expand my knowledge of R, quarto, tidyverse, and pharmaverse packages
- A personal playground for experimenting with the [pharmaverse](https://pharmaverse.org) ecosystem and learning clinical reporting in R.
- Store interesting snippets/programs along with example TLF outputs 

---

# Data Source

Work in this playground is based on the **CDISC Pilot Project** dataset - a publicly available reference dataset that mirrors a Phase III Alzheimer's disease trial.

| Domain | Standard | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| ADSL   | ADaM     | Subject-level analysis dataset |
| ADAE   | ADaM     | Adverse events |
| ADVS   | ADaM     | Vital signs |
| ADLBC  | ADaM     | Lab chemistry (continuous) |
| ADLBH  | ADaM     | Lab hematology |
| ADTTE  | ADaM     | Time-to-event |
| ADQSADAS | ADaM   | ADAS-Cog questionnaire |
